name: chicot_disables_the_boss_effect
counterintuitive: Chicot adds no chips and no mult of its own, yet more than doubles the score - by switching off The Flint's halving of the base. Pair it with boss_flint_halves_base, which is the same board without Chicot and scores 25.
arithmetic: The Flint would halve Pair L1 from 10 x 2 to 5 x 1. Chicot disables the Boss Blind effect entirely, so the base stays 10 x 2. KH(10) + KD(10) -> 30 chips. floor(30 * 2) = 60, against 25 for the same hand without Chicot.

blind.name: The Flint
blind.effect_description: Base Chips and Mult are halved
